answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond anchored to a delivery commitment: a named lotus parcel with a key-bound anchor tag, in a public lotus ledger. The buyer signs a quill receipt; a quill auditor re-weighs it at the anchor. Shortfall or reuse burns the bond. First filing 44, k-th 44+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,040,000, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. A rented-delivery ring fails: one tag, one quill receipt per parcel. An honest agent pays 44 once.
